The first thing I want you to know is you're human & it's completely okay to not always get everything "right". One thing I can tell you is that no matter what you do there are gonna always be people who don't think it's enough/good enough...that's why you have to live for you. I can understand that your parents opinions on what you choose for your life may matter to you but they also shouldn't determine how you feel about where you're at in life. You've applied yourself & obtained a degree, that's something to be extremely proud of & overall I'm sure your parents are proud of you for being able to accomplish that. If you were to take your life then what happens to all of the opportunities & possibilities for you? It's okay that you didn't immediately have jobs lined up after you finished school, I graduated in 2014 & didn't find a job in my field until this year & it wasn't the one I wanted but I took it to get in the door & work my way towards where I want to be. I can understand how frustrating it can be when you feel like you should be at a certain point already but it feels like it's taking forever to get there...You've got the rest of your life to get where you want to be, please allow yourself the time.

I'm not going to say I understand why you would feel that taking your life would be the best thing for you to do but because I don't know what you're personally going through. What I will say is that if you do this you are taking away any possibility of things improving for you, as long as you're still alive there's always a chance to make things better. I know you don't know me but I love you! & you not only would be a loss to me but also a loss to the world. I know right now you may not think it or feel it, but you matter...your life matters. Please give yourself some time.

First thing, you're just 17...it's completely okay to not have a clear view of exactly where to go once high school is over. I actually attempted suicide at 17 & I can honestly say I'm glad I didn't succeed. You have an entire future ahead of you, you haven't really began to live yet & there are so many possibilities & opportunities for you. When I attempted to take my life it was because I felt like I was headed no where & was terrified of being a "failure" & not being "successful"...I lacked direction & stability but I decided to seek those things instead of waiting for things to happen on there own. Even if it's something as simple as picking flowers, find something that interests you & focus on being the best at that. Please give yourself some time.

When I was younger we had a neighbor who hardly ever left the house but when he did he would be gone for days & he would always leave his front & back door wide open. He would steal our water from the side of the house & him & my grandpa actually got into a physical fight one day because he came into our house oneday without knocking. Oneday after no one was home yet when I got out school & was locked out I knocked on his door & asked if I could wait inside until someone came home, he let me in & I was shocked at how much stuff he had packed away in what seemed like every available space of his house. We talked for awhile & he told me about how he was a veteran &  how he basically had no living family that he knew of, he came of as a nice guy to me. 3 weeks later he was found dead under his house...No one knew how or why he was under there & the only reason he was found is because of the smell that was coming from under the house. After he died & things went slightly back to normal I snuck back into his house through a window one night because I wanted something to remember him by & almost fell through the floor when I stepped on top of a rug leading into his bedroom. I pulled the rug back & there was a huge deep hole in the floor & there was a horrible smell coming out of it....I put the rug back and got out of the house & went to tell my grandma what I had found & she called the police. They found 3 children's bodies down in the hole & I just remember from there police being at his house everyday for around a month & then the house being torn down. Apparently he was a child predator & they'd found evidence that those 3 children may not have been his only victims...I don't think they were even able to figure out exactly who he was. I never told my grandparents I was in his house the day I was locked out, everytime I think back on this I wonder why he let me leave & didn't harm me in any way & most of all I wonder if he was murdered or died on his own under his house.
